结语：新的开端？

Conclusion: A New Beginning?结语：新的开端？

— PDF 第 209 页 —

Every company, regardless of its origins, is becoming a digital company. This transformation requires the delivery of APIs and services to be consumed by mobile applications, devices in the internet of things (IoT), or even autonomous vehicles and systems. The increasing criticality of these systems means that these online systems must be built for redundancy, fault tolerance, and high availability. At the same time, the requirements of business necessitate rapid agility to develop and roll out new software, iterate on existing applications, or experiment with new user interfaces and APIs. The confluence of these requirements has led to an order of magnitude increase in the number of distributed systems that need to be built.

无论出身如何，每家公司都正在变成一家数字化公司。这一转型要求交付可供移动应用、物联网（IoT）设备、乃至自动驾驶汽车与各类系统调用的 API 与服务。这些系统日益关键，意味着它们必须为冗余、容错与高可用而构建。与此同时，业务要求快速敏捷地开发与发布新软件、在现有应用上迭代、或试验新的用户界面与 API。这些需求汇合在一起，使得需要构建的分布式系统数量增加了整整一个数量级。

The task of building these systems is still far too difficult. The overall cost of developing, updating, and maintaining such a system is far too high. Likewise, the set of people with the capabilities and skills to build such applications is far too small to address the growing need.

构建这些系统的任务仍然太过困难。开发、更新与维护这样一套系统的总体成本太高；同样，具备构建这类应用所需能力与技能的人太少，远不足以应对日益增长的需求。

Historically, when these situations presented themselves in software development and technology, new abstraction layers and patterns of software development emerged to make building software faster, easier, and more reliable. This first occurred with the development of the first compilers and programming languages. Later, the development of object-oriented programming languages and managed code occurred. Likewise, at each of these moments, these technical developments crystallized the distillation of the knowledge and practices of experts into a series of algorithms and patterns that could be applied by a much wider group of practitioners. Technological advancement combined with the establishment of patterns democratized the process of developing software and expanded the set of developers who could build applications on the new platform. This in turn led to the development of more applications and application diversity, which in turn expanded the market for these developers’ skills.

历史上，每当软件开发与技术领域出现这种局面，新的抽象层与软件开发模式就会应运而生，让构建软件变得更快、更轻松、更可靠。这最早发生在第一批编译器与编程语言出现之时；后来又有了面向对象编程语言与托管代码。同样，在每一个这样的时刻，这些技术进步都把专家的知识与实践凝练成一系列算法与模式，供更广泛的从业者加以应用。技术进步与模式的确立相结合，使软件开发过程走向民主化，扩大了能够在新平台上构建应用的开发者群体；这反过来又催生了更多应用与应用多样性，进而扩大了对这些开发者技能的市场需求。

— PDF 第 210 页 —

Again, we find ourselves at a moment of technological transformation. The need for distributed systems far exceeds our ability to deliver them. Fortunately, the development of technology has produced another set of tools to further expand the pool of developers capable of building these distributed systems. The recent development of containers and container orchestration has brought tools that enable rapid, easier development of distributed systems. With luck, these tools, when combined with the patterns and practices described in this book, can enhance and improve the distributed systems built by current developers, and more importantly, develop a whole new expanded group of developers capable of building these systems.

我们再一次站在了技术变革的关口。对分布式系统的需求，远远超出了我们交付它们的能力。幸运的是，技术的发展又带来了另一套工具，进一步扩充能够构建这些分布式系统的开发者队伍。近来容器与容器编排的发展，带来了让分布式系统开发更快、更轻松的工具。若一切顺利，这些工具与本书所述的模式和实践相结合，既能增强、改进当下开发者所构建的分布式系统，更重要的是，还能培养出一整支规模更大的、能够构建这些系统的新开发者队伍。

Patterns like sidecars, ambassadors, sharded services, FaaS, work queues, and more can form the foundation on which modern distributed systems are built. Distributed system developers should no longer be building their systems from scratch as individuals but rather collaborating together on reusable, shared implementations of canonical patterns that form the basis of all of the systems we collectively deploy. This will enable us to meet the demands of today’s reliable, scalable APIs and services and empower a new set of applications and services for the future.

边车、大使、分片服务、FaaS、工作队列等模式，可以构成现代分布式系统赖以构建的基础。分布式系统开发者不应再像单打独斗那样从零构建系统，而应协作共建可复用的、共享的经典模式实现——这些模式正是我们共同部署的所有系统的基石。如此，我们才能满足当今对可靠、可扩展的 API 与服务的需求，并为未来赋能一整套全新的应用与服务。
